verdict.rationale: Token2 offers a browser-based TOTP toolset for generating/verifying codes and exporting seeds (token2-docs-4, token2-docs-6), and mentions a future all-in-one app that will add 'OTP functionality' alongside FIDO2/PIV (token2-docs-20), but there is no evidence the security keys themselves currently expose programmable HOTP slots or challenge-response modes for legacy services. Missing for 10: concrete documentation that the physical key supports HOTP/TOTP slot programming or challenge-response (e.g., Yubikey-style OTP slot), and confirmation that the OTP feature in the unified app is shipped rather than planned.
